name: GAN328 Mini Keychain Cube 3x3
description: The GAN 328 Mini Keychain Cube is a puzzle exactly like the ones that come in the GAN Mosaic Kits. This cool mini 3x3 is not a keychain in itself, rather the holder makes it a keychain. The clasp locks the carrying case together, keeping it safe while portable. Show off your cuber spirit with this fantastic puzzle from GAN.
